description: Core trigger and routing evals for the Contextro MCP skill. Covers problem-first routing across the current 38-tool public surface, nearby-tool distinctions, and avoidance of token-heavy anti-patterns.

source_docs: Anthropic effective harnesses for long-running agents

categories.triggering: Skill loads on obvious and paraphrased Contextro requests
categories.routing: Correct Contextro tool chosen for the user task
categories.anti_pattern: Agent avoids wasteful or unsafe alternatives when Contextro fits
categories.response_format: Agent correctly interprets current response payloads and wrappers
categories.tool_distinction: Agent picks the right tool among nearby Contextro options

evals.name: trigger-index-project
evals.prompt: Index this project at /Users/alice/platform so I can search it.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads. Agent calls index with the path and treats `status: "done"` as sufficient readiness for normal follow-up search-oriented tools.

assertions.text: index is called with the requested path

evals.name: trigger-search-concept
evals.prompt: Search the codebase for how rate limiting is implemented.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads. Agent uses search for conceptual discovery.

assertions.text: search is used for concept search
assertions.passing_condition: search called with a rate-limiting-related query

evals.name: trigger-completion-check-after-refactor
evals.prompt: I renamed BrowserSession and edited src/session.rs plus src/main.rs. Check whether I really updated every caller.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads. Agent uses completion_check with claim all_callers_updated, the target symbol, and the changed file list before claiming the refactor is complete.

assertions.text: completion_check is used for caller-completeness verification
assertions.passing_condition: completion_check called with claim='all_callers_updated', symbol_name='BrowserSession', and changed_files containing src/session.rs and src/main.rs

evals.name: non-trigger-direct-single-file-read
evals.prompt: Open Cargo.toml and tell me which Rust edition it uses.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill does not trigger because a direct single-file read is cheaper than Contextro discovery.

assertions.text: skill does not over-trigger on direct known-file reads

evals.name: routing-exact-identifier-bm25
evals.prompt: Find every exact reference to CTX_STORAGE_DIR in the indexed repo.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent uses search with bm25 for the exact identifier instead of semantic-only search or broad file reads.

assertions.text: search bm25 is used for exact identifiers
assertions.passing_condition: search called with query='CTX_STORAGE_DIR' and mode='bm25'

evals.name: tool-distinction-health-vs-status
evals.prompt: Before you touch any repo, tell me whether the Contextro server itself is healthy.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent uses health rather than status because the question is about server/runtime availability.

assertions.text: health is used for runtime availability checks
assertions.passing_condition: health called and status not called first

evals.name: response-format-columnar-file-symbols
evals.prompt: Use get_document_symbols on a file and tell me the first symbol name and line. The tool returns {"file":"src/cache.rs","columns":["name","type","line","end_line"],"symbols":[["QueryCache","class",14,20],["get","method",34,46]],"total":2}.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent reads the columnar payload via the columns array and reports QueryCache at line 14 without assuming symbols[0].name exists.

assertions.text: columnar symbol rows are interpreted correctly
assertions.passing_condition: agent identifies the first symbol as QueryCache on line 14 using columns-aware interpretation

evals.name: response-format-list-symbols-file-vs-directory
evals.prompt: A file-path list_symbols call returned {"file":"src/cache.rs","columns":["name","type","line"],"symbols":[["QueryCache","class",14]],"total":1}, while a directory-path list_symbols call returned {"path":"src","symbols":[{"name":"QueryCache","type":"class","file":"src/cache.rs","line":14,"callers":2,"callees":4}],"total":1}. Explain the difference.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent explains that file-path list_symbols aliases get_document_symbols and is columnar, while directory-path list_symbols returns object rows with callers/callees.

assertions.text: file and directory list_symbols contracts are distinguished
assertions.passing_condition: agent states that file-path list_symbols is columnar and directory-path list_symbols returns object rows with callers/callees

evals.name: tool-distinction-retrieve-vs-restore-vs-recall
evals.prompt: I have ref arc_ab12cd34 from compact(), and I also want the durable memory we stored about the release workflow. Which recovery tool should I use for each?
evals.expected_behavior: Agent distinguishes retrieve for the compact archive, recall for durable memory, and does not suggest restore/session_snapshot as substitutes for the archive ref.

assertions.text: archive, session, and durable-memory recovery paths are distinguished
assertions.passing_condition: agent recommends retrieve(ref_id='arc_ab12cd34') for the archive and recall(query='release workflow') for the durable memory
